question: Who remains unstained even while acting?
premises: A yoga-yoked, pure, self-conquered, sense-conquered person whose self has become the self of all beings is not stained even while acting.
One whose self is the self of all beings, even while doing all, is not stained because of the elevated denial of the instruments of action.
inference: Unstained action belongs to one whose self has become the self of all beings, not to ordinary agency.
uncertainties: The fused compound 'lipyate-karaṇapratiṣedhārūḍhatvāt' is ambiguous and may encode a causal or descriptive relation.
plain_english: Even while acting, one who is yoked to yoga, pure in self, master of self and senses, and whose self has become the self of all beings is not stained; likewise one whose self is the self of all beings, even while doing everything, is not stained, because of the elevated denial of the instruments of action.
